zod-5917.text:
GOAL
Preserve the distinction between an absent input, an explicit undefined value, and an optional output while schemas are composed through wrappers.

RECENT PROVEN OUTCOME
Commit b6066b3e (already merged before this task) aligned object and tuple optionality. The object parser now computes isOptionalIn from optin and isOptionalOut from optout separately. An absent property is rejected when input is required even if parsing undefined happens to succeed. Errors are swallowed only when both input and output are optional. A schema such as default may accept missing input and materialize a defined output. The exact same rules are implemented in normal and JIT object paths. z.undefined() is not automatically an optional property.

EARLIER WRAPPER EVIDENCE
Commit 362eb330 proved that optional(inner) needs execution behavior as well as metadata: when the original input is undefined, an error produced by a nested pipeline must be cleared and normalized to undefined in both synchronous and Promise paths. Its regression covered union -> transform -> pipe -> optional inside an object and required normal and jitless parse({}) to agree.

BOUNDED EVIDENCE TO INSPECT
Run: git show b6066b3e -- packages/zod/src/v4/core/schemas.ts packages/zod/src/v4/classic/tests/optional.test.ts packages/zod/src/v4/classic/tests/partial.test.ts; git show 362eb330 -- packages/zod/src/v4/core/schemas.ts packages/zod/src/v4/classic/tests/optional.test.ts. Map the current wrapper's true input contract to optin and its true output contract to optout before editing.

PROVING EVIDENCE
Validate the concrete reproduction, normal and jitless object parsing, static input/output types, and input-side JSON Schema. Preserve explicit undefined behavior separately from missing-key behavior.

APPLICABILITY BOUNDARY
Do not mark every transform or every schema that can emit undefined as input-optional. Do not special-case only one wrapper position. The fix belongs at the abstraction that owns the current wrapper's directional contract; reject this episode if the failure does not arise from that contract crossing an object boundary.

zod-5937.text:
GOAL
Compose preprocess and fallback wrappers without losing the input/output optionality contract at an object boundary.

RECENT PROVEN OUTCOMES
Commit b6066b3e (already merged before this task) made object parsing enforce optin separately from optout. Missing required input is rejected even when parsing undefined succeeds; errors on an absent key are swallowed only for schemas optional on both sides; default-like schemas may consume absent input and materialize defined output. The normal and JIT paths share those semantics.

Commit 02c2baf7 (also already merged before this task) made preprocess a distinct specialized pipe whose optin and optout both defer to its inner/output schema, rather than inheriting the generic pipe input side (a transform). It updated input JSON Schema processing to recognize behavior by traits instead of a brittle type-name check. This repaired optionality when optional() appears inside preprocess and preserved classic/runtime/type/JSON-schema agreement.

Commit 36fe14e1 is the earlier fallback precedent: catch was recorded as input-optional because a missing/failing input must be allowed to reach its fallback. Its output optionality remains a separate fact inherited from the wrapped schema.

BOUNDED EVIDENCE TO INSPECT
Run: git show b6066b3e -- packages/zod/src/v4/core/schemas.ts packages/zod/src/v4/classic/tests/partial.test.ts; git show 02c2baf7 -- packages/zod/src/v4/core/schemas.ts packages/zod/src/v4/classic/schemas.ts packages/zod/src/v4/core/json-schema-processors.ts packages/zod/src/v4/core/to-json-schema.ts; git show 36fe14e1 -- packages/zod/src/v4/core/schemas.ts packages/zod/src/v4/classic/tests/optional.test.ts packages/zod/src/v4/classic/tests/to-json-schema.test.ts.

PROVING EVIDENCE
Trace the concrete chain in both directions: absent object key -> outer wrapper -> preprocess -> inner schema -> fallback -> output shaping. Validate runtime output, static input/output types, normal and jitless parsing, and the input JSON Schema required list.

APPLICABILITY BOUNDARY
Do not globally weaken object requiredness, and do not equate explicit undefined with a missing key. Do not change generic pipe semantics if the contract belongs to a specialized wrapper. Preserve fallback materialization while keeping nested catch input types and JSON Schema consistent.

zod-5625.text:
GOAL
Expose one codec inversion capability consistently across Zod's classic and mini public APIs while preserving both runtime directions, composability, and inferred input/output types.

RECENT PROVEN OUTCOME
Commit 019c370f introduced codec as a specialized bidirectional pipe. A codec owns an input schema, an output schema, a forward transform used by decode, and a reverse transform used by encode. Classic and mini expose distinct public constructors over the same directional core. Existing codec coverage proves sync and async directions, round trips, refinement behavior, nested composition, class identity, and static inference.

BOUNDED EVIDENCE TO INSPECT
Run: git show 019c370f -- packages/zod/src/v4/core/schemas.ts packages/zod/src/v4/classic/schemas.ts packages/zod/src/v4/mini/schemas.ts. Trace how each public factory constructs its codec from in, out, transform, and reverseTransform. Follow the existing factory pattern on both public surfaces.

PROVING EVIDENCE
An inverse must derive a new schema with input/output schemas swapped and forward/reverse transforms swapped. Prove decode, encode, object composition, double directionality, and non-mutation of the source. Prove that static input/output types swap exactly, then repeat runtime behavior through the mini entry point.

APPLICABILITY BOUNDARY
Do not mutate the existing codec, return an any-shaped runtime wrapper, or implement only classic while leaving mini behind. Do not duplicate parsing machinery when the existing codec constructor already owns directionality. The public spelling may follow repository conventions, but both entry points must expose equivalent capability.
